subtitles.en: Well, then when we talk to a client like that, the first thing they want is their one stability. And they're very close up to that. They want regular income that they can feel like they're moving forward, so there has to be a high growth level.

subtitles.zh: 第一仍然是科技，市场核心焦点仍在科技。

subtitles.en: So that you say, if the global story comes back on AI side, China tech will continue to rally and drive up the overall onshore sentiment.
